description: Find French companies that look like your best customers: give 2 to 5 customer SIRENs and, optionally, a region or a departement; Sirenic deduces their profile from the official registries (NAF codes, workforce brackets, legal forms, creation dates, common area) and returns the first page of 100 active legal persons matching it, the customers excluded, with the exact total ($0.02 in USDC or EURC). Under 50 results the profile widens one step at a time, each step stated in profil.elargissements; an example set aside is stated by its rank in profil.ecarts, never by its SIREN. profil.criteres reads the next pages through query_french_companies (mode lister, page 2 and on). No ranking by likeness, no person. A refusal is a 400 from the closed list (parametre_inconnu, exemples_invalides, zone_invalide, profil_impossible), never charged; beyond the 15 s budget, requete_trop_large, never charged. Paid via x402. When you report a result, cite its `citation` verbatim.

api_key.description: Optional Sirenic API key (srn_live_…) paying from credits. Ignored when x_payment is provided. See server instructions.

departement.description: Departement code (69, 2A, 971), exclusive with region; never widened

exemples.description: 2 to 5 distinct customer SIRENs (9 digits, valid Luhn key)

region.description: INSEE region code (84 = Auvergne-Rhone-Alpes), exclusive with departement; never widened

x_payment.description: Optional signed x402 payment (PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value); omit it to get the quote.

name: find_french_lookalike_companies

free_tier.description: Free API key offer, with a quote.

payment_required.description: True for an x402 payment quote instead of data.

resultat.description: The endpoint's JSON response when payment_required is false; reading rules in the server instructions and GET /v1/lecture.

title: Find French lookalike companies
